decisionsTitle: «Calculator de ritm» in kilometres or miles: «Unitatea de măsură», kilometres by default (amending §922, §926)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-10**, on «Unelte»: «vreau să pot schimba și unitatea de măsură, deși default să fie km și minute». Asked, he chose one choice between kilometres and miles over a second one for typing the pace as a speed.

**Decision.** Under «Ce vrei să afli?», a second radio, «Unitatea de măsură»: «Kilometri (km)», checked on every visit, or «Mile (mi)» — the statute mile, 1,609344 km. The unit is the distance's and the pace's; the time is the time. In miles the distance box reads «Mile», the pace «Ritmul, pe milă», the answer «min/milă» or «mi», the speed «mph»; a race button fills in its official length in the unit picked (the half marathon is 13,1094 miles). Switching converts the distance and the pace on the screen, so the run stays the same run. The calculator keeps the unrounded value of a distance or a pace it wrote — a race picked, an answer carried by a switch of «Ce vrei să afli?», a unit converted — while the box still shows it, so a marathon taken to miles and back reads 42,195 km again and the time does not move by the boxes' rounding; typing in the box lets it go. The «?» gives the formulas with a mile example, and the mile's length. Nothing is remembered between visits and nothing is sent: the unit is the island's own state (`src/modules/tools/pace.ts`, `tests/unit/tools/pace.test.ts`).

**Refused.** A second choice to type the pace as a speed (km/h, the treadmill's way) — offered, not chosen. Remembering the unit between visits — kilometres are the default the owner asked for.
changelogLine: - **The pace calculator in miles too** — «Unelte» → «Calculator de ritm»: «Unitatea de măsură», kilometres (min/km, km/h) by default or miles (min/milă, mph); switching converts the boxes and keeps the same run. §NNN.
